title: 2017 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement: In the arrangement of letters and numerals below, by how many different paths can one spell \(\mathrm{AMC8}\)? Beginning at the \(A\) in the middle, a path allows only moves from one letter to an adjacent (above, below, left, or right, but not diagonal) letter. One example of such a path is traced in the picture.

solutions.text:
Starting from \(A,\) there are \(4\) ways to reach an \(M.\) From each \(M,\) there are \(3\) ways to reach a \(C.\) From each \(C,\) there are \(2\) ways to reach an \(8.\) Multiplying all these possibilities, we get \(4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 = 24.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Count choices one step at a time from the central \(A\).
From each \(M\), count adjacent \(C\)’s, then from each \(C\), count adjacent \(8\)’s.
